paragraphs.text: Sliv-Mizzet is a legendary dragon sliver from an unknown plane.

Sliv-Mizzet is called a Hivemind and appears to be a large flying sliver dragon hybrid. It seems to have a large long serpent-like body with the head of a dragon, two large wings, and numerous small legs along its body. It only appears on a playtest card making its existence likely non-canon to the normal timeline .
